info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Workforce Training By Workforce Training Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows updates to existing workforce training records within the Banking Human Resource Management system. It facilitates modifications to training details using a specified workforce training ID, ensuring that all relevant information is current and accurate. Typical consumers include HR professionals and training coordinators who manage employee development programs. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their workforce training initiatives and ensure compliance with skill requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to make updates to a specific workforce training resource identified by its unique identifier. Utilize this operation to modify details such as training content, schedules, and participant information.
